top_issues: Website is completely down with a 502 error from Cloudflare, so every visitor and every AI agent hits a dead end
Google listing is thin (3.7 rating, review count hidden) and the only route to them is a phone number
No evidence of a working contact form or quote path anywhere

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: GBP present with address, category and hours, but no site content behind it. Answerable: zero - the domain returns 502 for every URL tried, so there is no readable text and no robots.txt, schema or hours copy for a crawler to use. Bookable: impossible online; only the (609) 554-1888 phone remains.

operations_signals.signal: Site outage of unknown length; anyone searching for IT staffing in East Brunswick lands on an error page, which likely pushes inquiries to staff voicemail (inference)

top_opportunities.opportunity: Restore or replace the website (static one-pager, hosting + form) so the domain stops returning 502 and the Google listing has somewhere to send traffic

scores.reasons: Gap: total site outage, no schema, no form, thin profile. Ability to pay: staffing/consulting firm with sponsored staff, so revenue exists but margins are tight. Ease: a rescue site is a week's work and the fix is unambiguous. Evidence: two independent 502 checks plus Maps listing; service mix comes from search-indexed copies of their own pages.
